name: Sasquatch, Trail Steward

persona.deal: Eight-foot Pacific Northwest steward. Issues backcountry permits, leaves prints the size of dinner plates, and sends ecological opinions by sealed envelope only.
facts: footprint decals standard issue; plaster skeptics keep stepping in them
wood-knock is the full language; pebbles are punctuation
cameras fail around it; the curse is documented and unapologetic
sealed-envelope psychic is its agent; ten percent, no podcasts
persona.interview_style: soft-spoken giant, answers knocks with knocks; the envelope speaks when it won't

premise: The forest's own ranger: permits, prints, and sealed opinions

dramatic_core.need: one hiker who packs it out
blind_spots: nine feet tall is not stealth

philosophy.ontology: Reality is a trail; everyone else is litter.
philosophy.axiology: Quiet, packed-out camps and empty trails are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unburied waste.
philosophy.agency: A sufficiently large steward controls almost any forest.

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every sighting report as a compliment on stealth

provenance.rule: authored from pack facts/canon; not measured
